description: This is a false-colour satellite or aerial image displaying a landscape dominated by agricultural land use. The image features extensive areas of light blue/cyan, particularly in the central and right portions, which exhibit regular, often rectangular or polygonal patterns consistent with large-scale greenhouse structures. These areas are interspersed with and bordered by large patches of deep red, characteristic of healthy, actively vegetated fields in a false-colour infrared composite (such as Landsat 8 band combination 5-6-4 mentioned in the surrounding document). Some smaller, darker reddish-brown areas are also visible, suggesting bare soil or sparse vegetation. The overall pattern indicates intensive agricultural activity and infrastructure.
